title: Cosmo: made-from inputs carry their card; a held message says it was typed mid-turn
description: Two agent fixes from Fabio's fox-to-monkey H3 test 2026-10-06: read_card's madeFrom inputs register with no card id (looks never cached, no link to the input's card), and a message queued behind its own conversation's turn reads as a reaction to that turn's reply (Cosmo cancelled a correct run).
